articles.title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
articles.snippet: The committee that needs to advance President Donald Trump's nominees responded quickly to set his SEC picks for review next week.

articles.title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
articles.snippet: U.S. President Donald Trump has named two potential commissioners each to the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

articles.title: Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks
articles.snippet: The White House also named a former CFTC commissioner and two CLARITY Act veterans as nominees to fill vacancies at the SEC and CFTC.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

articles.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
articles.snippet: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.
